tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i skyabs 'og rnams kyi gnod byed la springs pa bzhugs so// rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bi rū pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog pho brang rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi gzhal yas khang du byin rlabs rim can bzhugs pa'i gnas nas/ gang gi brtul zhugs 'dzin zhing gsang sngags rgyun mi chad pa'i rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyi yi ge 'di zhes bya bar gnod byed rnams la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gi bka' lung gis go bar bya ba 'di pa dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song zhing / rje btsun bi rū pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i gdan sar 'cha' ba yin pas mi nor phyugs bcas la gnod 'gal log par 'gro ba nam yang ma byed par tshe dang rigs rgyud longs spyod 'phel ba'i grogs dan yang dag gyis/ de'i dge bas rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi go 'phang zung 'jug gi sar snyegs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes go bar bya ba'i yi ge stobs kyi mgon po'i gdan sa nas bris// ༈ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum yi dam bka'/ /chos srung nor lha rnal 'byor bcas kyi 'phrin/ /mtshan mo rgyu ba'i gdon tshogs la springs pa/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su bka' bstod cing / /rnal 'byor nged la dad ldan dam tshig can/ /'di zhes bya ba'i lus ngag yid gsum la/ /gnod 'tshe kun spongs phan sems dge mtshan gyi/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor kun nas rgyas pa dang / /ci bsam 'bad med 'grub pa'i grogs dan gyis// //sa mā ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu// //zhes dpal sa skya nas bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i skyabs 'og rnams kyi gnod byed la springs pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
